# Kraken quarterly OHLCVT archives - checksums

<!-- generated by `uv run sextant archive scan`; do not hand-edit -->

The archives are roughly 4.5 GB and git-ignored, and they arrive by hand
because the venue publishes them through a Google Drive folder that refuses
anonymous downloads with a folder-wide quota. These hashes are what lets a
later reader verify a download is the same dataset the committed results were
computed from, without re-acquiring anything.

Verify with `sha256sum` on Linux, or `Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256` on
Windows. `sextant archive scan` re-hashes every file and every subsequent read
checks against the manifest, raising `ChecksumMismatch` rather than reading a
truncated file as a short quarter.
